trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document) MATCH (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City) OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) = 1949 OR (o.name IS NOT NULL AND o.name <> 'Ted Leonsis' AND o.name <> 'Professional Basketball Club LLC') RETURN DISTINCT c.city_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
